stories.title: Saudi Arabia shuts down major East-West oil pipeline after drone attack, compounding Red Sea disruption
stories.reason: The 745-mile pipeline carrying 4-5% of global oil supply was Saudi Arabia's bypass around the blockaded Strait of Hormuz, and its closure alongside the Houthis' new grip on the Red Sea has squeezed crude routes on both sides of the Arabian Peninsula.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO calls for the AI industry to deliberately slow capability development after a safety researcher's alarming resignation
stories.reason: Dario Amodei's essay proposes independent reviewers and cross-lab safety coordination days after researcher Jacob Coxon quit warning that AI could 'kill us all by the end of the decade,' with Musk and Altman both signaling support for the plan.

stories.title: Modi and Xi hold first substantial bilateral talks in three years at BRICS, agree to a 'fair, reasonable' border settlement
stories.reason: Xi's first visit to India in seven years and the leaders' agreement that 'differences should not become disputes' signals a significant thaw between the world's two most populous countries six years after their deadly border clash.

stories.title: Pentagon in talks to lend AI cloud startup Fluidstack $5 billion, its largest loan to date
stories.reason: The Office of Strategic Capital loan would fund data-center component manufacturing to shore up the US supply chain, deepening the Pentagon's direct financial stake in the AI buildout Anthropic is also backing with its own $50 billion Fluidstack partnership.

stories.title: Markets price an 80% chance of a Fed rate hike Wednesday after hot inflation data
stories.reason: August producer prices rose 5.4% year-over-year and core CPI came in hotter than expected, pushing traders to bet the FOMC will raise rates from its current 3.5-3.75% range despite the drag from the Iran war on growth.

stories.title: Apple opens pre-orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and its first foldable iPhone Duo ahead of Friday's launch
stories.reason: Pre-orders opened Saturday for the new lineup alongside Apple Watch Series 12, Watch Ultra 4 and AirPods 5, with iOS 27 rolling out Monday ahead of devices reaching customers September 18.

stories.title: US Space Force awards Antares $161 million to build America's first orbital nuclear reactor since 1965
stories.reason: The Strategic Breakthrough award tasks the startup with a ground demonstration and flight certification of its heat-pipe microreactor, part of a Trump administration push for orbital reactors by 2028 as space becomes a new nuclear-power frontier.

stories.title: Bangladesh to launch a nationwide measles vaccination campaign for children up to age 6 on September 25
stories.reason: The renewed mop-up drive comes after April and May's emergency campaign failed to stop transmission, with officials noting most new cases are in children who were never vaccinated in the world's worst current measles outbreak.
